description: Search Deezer and manage your likes and playlists from Claude.
long_description:
Search tracks, albums and artists, browse charts and an artist's top tracks and radio: no setup needed.

To use your own account (likes, playlists, Flow, listening history):
1. Log in at https://www.deezer.com in Google Chrome (or Arc, Brave or Edge) on this Mac.
2. Ask Claude, for example: "what are my latest Deezer likes?". The extension reads your Deezer session from the browser.
3. The first time, macOS may ask whether to allow access to "Chrome Safe Storage": click Always Allow.

If that does not work, paste your arl cookie into this extension's settings instead (deezer.com → View → Developer → Developer Tools → Application → Cookies → arl).

Liking a track or changing a playlist always asks you first.

arl.title: Deezer arl cookie (optional)
arl.description: Only if reading the session from your browser does not work. The value of the arl cookie on deezer.com.
